title: 梯子与脚手架
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/142_梯子与脚手架.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/142_梯子与脚手架/src.py

points.K4: 用前检查，不刷不透明漆
points.K17: 移动脚手架与登高平台

shots.scene: 欣欣扶着人字梯，旁边是脚手架
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a stepladder beside a small scaffold in front of a laboratory building, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章第五课：梯子与脚手架。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指提醒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger in warning, a ladder icon beside it.
shots.narration: 登高工具用不好，自己就成了危险。

shots.scene: 阿杰踩着带轮子的转椅去够高柜上的盒子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands on a rolling office chair to reach a box on top of a tall lab cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰踩着转椅，去够高柜上的盒子。

shots.scene: 转椅一滑，阿杰晃了一下
shots.prompt_en: The chair rolls slightly and the young male student wobbles, grabbing the cabinet edge.
shots.narration: 椅子一滑，差点摔下来。

shots.scene: 小研推来一个踏凳
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student brings over a sturdy step stool and points at it.
shots.narration: 小研：用踏凳！转椅不是梯子。

shots.scene: 窗外，实验楼外墙正在搭脚手架
shots.prompt_en: Through the lab window, workers are building a scaffold on the outside wall of the building.
shots.narration: 窗外，实验楼也正在搭脚手架。

shots.scene: 转椅、纸箱、实验凳打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rolling chair, a cardboard box and a lab stool, each crossed out under a high shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 高处取物，不踩转椅、纸箱和凳子。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在平整地面上用稳固踏凳取高柜上的空盒子（全景）
shots.prompt_en: Wide shot: a student steps onto a sturdy step stool on a level floor and lifts an empty box down from a high shelf.
shots.narration: 用稳固的踏凳或人字梯，有人扶稳。

shots.scene: 重物和液体放在柜子下层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cabinet with heavy bottles and liquids on the lower shelves and light empty boxes on top. No text.
shots.narration: 重物、液体和危险试剂放低处。

shots.scene: 通道无杂物，地面擦干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clear aisle with no boxes and a mop drying a wet floor. No text.
shots.narration: 通道不堆物，地面湿了及时擦干。

shots.scene: 从梯子上头朝下摔落的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person falling backward from a short ladder, head toward the floor, a red warning. No text.
shots.narration: 梯子不高，摔下也可能致命。

shots.scene: 有人扶梯、站稳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one person on a ladder and another holding the ladder steady at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 用梯子也要有人扶、站得稳。

shots.scene: 在梯上急转身、往下跳，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person twisting around on a ladder and another jumping off a ladder, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不在梯上急转身，不从梯上跳下。

shots.scene: 高度、承重、材质、用途四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a height ruler, a weight, a material sample and a task icon, beside a ladder. No text.
shots.narration: 选梯子：看高度、承重、材质、用途。

shots.scene: 靠近电线选绝缘梯，金属梯打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an insulating fiberglass ladder with a tick near electrical cables, a metal ladder crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 靠近带电体，选绝缘材质的梯子。

shots.scene: 合格标识、不够高打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ladder too short with a person on tiptoe crossed out, a ladder of proper height with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 高度够用，不踮脚、不加垫。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，不刷不透明漆
shots.scene: 【实拍】检查人字梯梯脚防滑垫、踏板和铰链（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands checking the rubber feet, the steps and the hinges of a stepladder.
shots.narration: 用前查梯脚、踏板、铰链和撑杆。
overlay: 用前检查，不刷不透明漆

shots.section_title: 用前检查，不刷不透明漆
shots.scene: 油漆盖住裂纹的剖面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wooden ladder rail painted over, a hidden crack under the paint revealed by a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 不刷不透明漆，会盖住裂纹缺陷。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，不刷不透明漆
shots.scene: 坏梯子挂禁用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ladder with a broken rung and a do not use tag, moved aside. No text.
shots.narration: 有损坏的，挂牌停用，不凑合。

shots.scene: 两手一脚、两脚一手的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person on a ladder with two hands and one foot touching it, then two feet and one hand, both with ticks. No text.
shots.narration: 金规则：始终三点接触。

shots.scene: 【实拍】面朝梯子，在最低两级示范三点接触上梯，同伴扶梯（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person faces a stepladder and climbs the lowest two steps keeping three points of contact while a partner holds it.
shots.narration: 面朝梯子上下，手里不拿东西。

shots.scene: 站在最顶层打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing on the top cap of a stepladder, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不站最顶层，身体不探出梯外。

shots.scene: 靠墙梯子的合适角度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a straight ladder leaning on a wall at a proper steep angle, a protractor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 靠墙梯子，倾斜角度要合适。

shots.scene: 太陡后翻、太平滑脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one ladder too upright tipping backward and one too flat sliding out at the base, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 太陡会后翻，太平会滑脱。

shots.scene: 梯子上端伸出平台一段
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ladder top extending above a roof edge so the climber can hold it while stepping off. No text.
shots.narration: 上端伸出平台一段，方便扶握。

shots.scene: 梯脚防滑、上端固定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: anti slip feet on the ladder base and the top tied to a fixed point. No text.
shots.narration: 梯脚防滑，上端固定，地面平整。

shots.scene: 两人同上人字梯，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two people climbing both sides of a stepladder at the same time, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 双面梯，不能两人同时上。

shots.scene: 一人在上，一人在下扶，撑杆锁定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one person on the stepladder, another holding it below, the spreader bar locked open. No text.
shots.narration: 一人上，一人扶，撑杆锁好。

shots.scene: 人字梯完全打开，四个梯脚着地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stepladder fully opened with all four feet flat on a level floor, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 完全打开，四脚平稳着地再上。

shots.scene: 脚手架托着人、材料、工具
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scaffold holding a worker, boards and a toolbox at height. No text.
shots.narration: 脚手架，是托人托料的临时平台。

shots.scene: 固定式与移动式
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fixed tube scaffold along a building wall and a mobile scaffold tower on wheels. No text.
shots.narration: 分固定式和移动式。

shots.scene: 落地、悬挑、悬挂、满堂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four scaffold icons, ground supported, cantilevered, suspended and full coverage indoor. No text.
shots.narration: 还有落地、悬挑、悬挂、满堂等形式。

shots.scene: 踏板滑脱、支撑塌落
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scaffold board slipping off and a brace collapsing, warning icons. No text.
shots.narration: 踏板、支撑滑脱，架子会塌。

shots.scene: 地面松软、拉结不到位，架子倾斜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scaffold leaning on soft uneven ground with missing wall ties. No text.
shots.narration: 地面松软、拉结不够，架子会倒。

shots.scene: 人滑倒、物体坠落、护栏缺失
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker slipping on a board, a tool falling and a missing guardrail section. No text.
shots.narration: 人会滑倒坠落，东西会砸人。

shots.scene: 靠近电线的脚手架
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scaffold too close to overhead power lines, a lightning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 离电线太近，还会触电。

shots.scene: 立杆、横杆、扣件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scaffold section with vertical standards, horizontal ledgers and couplers highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 立杆、横杆、扣件搭成骨架。

shots.scene: 斜撑、底座、脚手板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: diagonal braces, base plates on sole boards and platform boards on top, highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 斜撑、底座，上面铺脚手板。

shots.scene: 护栏、挡脚板、爬梯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scaffold platform with a guardrail, a toe board and an access ladder, all ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 护栏、挡脚板、爬梯，一样不少。

shots.scene: 搭架前查看地下空洞、沟渠、软土
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of the ground under a planned scaffold showing a hollow, a trench and soft soil. No text.
shots.narration: 搭架前，先看地基有无空洞软土。

shots.scene: 持证架子工搭设
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: scaffold workers with harnesses and blank operator certificates building a scaffold. No text.
shots.narration: 由持证的架子工搭设，材料合格。

shots.scene: 按要求拉结墙体、设斜撑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wall ties connecting a scaffold to the building and diagonal braces in place. No text.
shots.narration: 按方案拉结、设斜撑，远离电线。

shots.scene: 堆料前先看承重
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scaffold platform with a weight icon and a stack of bricks, a load limit icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 堆料之前，先弄清它能承多重。

shots.scene: 搭好后验收，挂牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inspector checking a finished scaffold and hanging a tag at the access point. No text.
shots.narration: 搭好后先验收合格，再挂牌使用。

shots.scene: 红、黄、绿三色牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three scaffold tags, red, yellow and green, each with a simple icon, a stop hand, a harness and a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 红牌禁用，黄牌限制使用，绿牌可用。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在校园施工现场看脚手架入口处的挂牌（中景，不上架）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person standing at the foot of a campus construction scaffold, looking at the inspection tag at the access point.
shots.narration: 没挂牌或挂禁用牌，一律不上。

shots.scene: 仪器上的停用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab instrument with an out of service tag and a hand kept away from it. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室仪器挂停用牌，也别碰。

shots.scene: 工人上架前查看踏板、护栏、底座
shots.prompt_en: A worker checks the boards, guardrail and base plates at the foot of a scaffold before climbing.
shots.narration: 上架前，自己先检查。

shots.scene: 检查清单：立杆、横杆、斜撑、拉结、扣件、踏板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with scaffold part icons, standards, ledgers, braces, ties, couplers and boards. No text.
shots.narration: 看骨架、拉结、踏板、护栏和爬梯。

shots.scene: 使用前、改动后、恶劣天气后、被撞后
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a calendar start, a wrench change, a storm and a vehicle bump, each leading to an inspection. No text.
shots.narration: 改动后、恶劣天气后、被撞后，重新查。

shots.scene: 有疑问就不上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker with a question mark stepping back from a scaffold ladder. No text.
shots.narration: 有疑问就别上，找管理人员。

shots.scene: 随手找的木板打叉，专用踏板打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a random wooden plank crossed out and a proper scaffold board with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 踏板坏了，只能用专用踏板换。

shots.scene: 踏板固定绑牢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: scaffold boards tied down to the ledgers so they cannot slide. No text.
shots.narration: 踏板要固定，不然会滑动翻落。

shots.scene: 搭接够长、铺满铺严
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: boards overlapping enough at the supports and laid side by side with very small gaps. No text.
shots.narration: 搭接要够长，缝隙要小。

shots.scene: 缝大踩空、工具漏下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wide gap between boards with a foot slipping in and a tool falling through, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 缝大了会踩空，还会漏下工具。

shots.scene: 踩交叉支撑往上爬，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker climbing the cross braces of a scaffold like a ladder, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 交叉支撑不是梯子，不能踩着爬。

shots.scene: 走专用爬梯上下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker climbing a built in access ladder inside the scaffold with three points of contact. No text.
shots.narration: 上下要走专用爬梯或通道。

shots.scene: 工人自己拆掉一根杆，架子晃动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker removing one tube from a scaffold and the whole structure wobbling, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 嫌碍事自己拆杆，整个架子会不稳。

shots.scene: 架子工凭许可拆除
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: certified scaffold workers dismantling a scaffold with a blank permit on a board. No text.
shots.narration: 只能由架子工，凭许可来改、来拆。

shots.scene: 安全带挂在架子横杆上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lanyard hooked onto a scaffold tube, the scaffold tipping, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 安全带不随便挂在架子上。

shots.scene: 挂在独立牢固的锚点上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lanyard hooked to an independent anchor on the building structure above the worker, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 挂在独立、牢固、经确认的锚点。

shots.scene: 搭不了架子，用安全网和安全带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety net under a work area and a worker in a harness on a lifeline, no scaffold. No text.
shots.narration: 搭不了架子，用安全网和安全带。

shots.section_title: 移动脚手架与登高平台
shots.scene: 移动脚手架：轮锁、支腿、内梯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mobile scaffold tower with locked wheels, outriggers and an internal ladder, each ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 移动脚手架：轮能锁、有支腿、有内梯。
overlay: 移动脚手架与登高平台

shots.section_title: 移动脚手架与登高平台
shots.scene: 太高太窄打叉，高了要拉结
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tall narrow tower tipping over crossed out, a tower tied to the building wall with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 不能太高太窄，按说明书控制高度。

shots.section_title: 移动脚手架与登高平台
shots.scene: 【实拍】踩下移动登高平台的脚轮锁（脚部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a foot pressing down the wheel lock of a mobile access platform on a level lab floor.
shots.narration: 实验室移动平台，先锁死脚轮。

shots.section_title: 移动脚手架与登高平台
shots.scene: 上面有人时推动平台，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person pushing a mobile platform while another person stands on top, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 上面有人时，绝不能推动平台。

shots.section_title: 移动脚手架与登高平台
shots.scene: 工具放工具袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person on a mobile platform with tools in a closed tool bag clipped to the rail. No text.
shots.narration: 工具放进工具袋，防止掉落伤人。

shots.scene: 踏凳、梯子三点接触
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a step stool and a ladder with three contact points. No text.
shots.narration: 登高用合格梯凳，用前查，三点接触。

shots.scene: 人字梯一人上、不站顶层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, one person on a stepladder and a crossed top step. No text.
shots.narration: 人字梯一人上一人扶，不站顶层。

shots.scene: 持证搭设、绿牌、自查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a certified scaffold worker, a green tag and a magnifier on a board. No text.
shots.narration: 脚手架持证搭设，验收挂牌，上前自查。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在围挡起来的沟槽旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fenced trench on a campus road and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：开挖作业。
